 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
2 19-10-2023 Heard Mr. Harsh Ranjan, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and Mr. Arun Kumar Singh, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Gaunaha P.S. Case No. 115 of 2023,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Allegedly on a direction of the Civil Surgeon, West Champaran, Bettiah, a raid has been conducted in connection with running of illegal hospitals/nursing homes, by the Incharge Medical Officer and Block Health Manager, along with Officer Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64870 of 2023(2)
dt.19-10-2023 In Charge.
In course of raid, Appolo Hospital and Jai Mata Di Hospital were found to be running in private residential house and no doctor was present.

During inquiry, the officials came to know from the villagers that the hospitals/nursing homes was being run by the petitioner nos. 2 &
3.
The name of the petitioner no. 1 has been disclosed as one of the doctor of the nursing home.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submit that the petitioners have neither any concern with the Appolo Hospital and Jai Mata Di Hospital, which was admittedly being run in the house of Umesh Sah.
Surprisingly, the said Umesh Sah in whose house, the hospitals/nursing homes were running, he has not been made accused in this case.

So far the petitioner no. 1 is concerned, learned counsel for the petitioners submit that the patient has disclosed the name of Dr.
Raju Kumar Bishwas @ Raju Kumar Biswas and Dr. S. Kumar, however, he denied this allegation that the petitioner no. 1 is anyhow rendered any treatment to the patient Damini Kumar.

entities.text: Raju Kumar Bishwas @ Raju Kumar Biswas
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: He lastly submits that the petitioners are men of fair antecedent and they undertake that they will fully cooperate in the investigation or in the proceeding of the Court.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64870 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 opposes the bail application.

6. Regard being had to the submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the fact that there is no material suggesting any connection of the petitioners with the hospital/nursing homes,
in question, coupled with their fair antecedents and the fact that the hospitals/nursing homes being run in the house of Umesh Sah, let the petitioners abovenamed be released on bail, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order, upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court of 2nd Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bettiah, West Champaran in connection with Gaunaha P.S. Case No. 115 of 2023, subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) Cr.P.C. with the further condition that one of the bailors shall be the own/close family members of the petitioners.
(Harish Kumar, J) shoaib/-
